items.why: Meta is lagging the broader tech rebound as headlines ask whether the AI stock market boom is beginning to end.
Tesla is up with the broader tape as dip buying resumes and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq climb, per Yahoo Finance. No single Tesla-specific headline.
Small caps are riding the earnings-fueled rebound, with solid earnings and falling crude oil lifting stocks, per CNBC.
Alphabet is under pressure as an economist warns an AI bust could come from places investors are not watching, souring sentiment on AI names.

summary: Stocks are rebounding Tuesday afternoon, with the Dow jumping 500 points on solid earnings and falling crude oil. Tech is bouncing back from Friday's selloff, though some mega-cap names are lagging the tape.
